forecasts.base_forecast_provenance: SYNTHETIC replica of the M4 gates example() forecast (TREND family, DIRECTION/PATH/PERSIST events, five return quantiles)
forecasts.label_formula: direction=UP if (d+i)%2==0 else DOWN; path=UP_FIRST if (d+i)%3==0 else DOWN_FIRST; terminal_return=0.001*((d%7)-3)
forecasts.block_rule: one trading-day block per synthetic day (day-%03d); same day never split into blocks

replay_metrics.input: the decision_replay_filled SYNTHETIC replay result built once in setup (not timed)
